answer: Latency fingerprint ledger. Each agent’s request timing is checked against a shared beacon, and reply delays are scored for variance. Like a gale scattering seeds, honest agents show stable jitter; sybils cloned on one host share timing artifacts. Identities whose timing clusters overlap beyond a threshold enter a garden quarantine and lose routing priority. Attacker cost: distinct network paths and clock sources per identity, raising per-identity overhead substantially.
